result.summary: Found 1 issue: the restaurant name in the first 'Popular right now' card is clipped. The rest of the screen (header, search, promo banner, 'Fastest near you' carousel, and bottom navigation) renders correctly. Partially visible carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport were excluded as expected behavior.

issues.description: The title of the first card in the 'Popular right now' list reads 'Tokumaru Rameı' instead of 'Tokumaru Ramen'. The final 'n' is cut off mid-glyph, with no ellipsis, even though there is plenty of empty space between the title and the rating. This looks like an overly narrow or fixed-width text container with overflow hidden, and the name can be misread.
issues.suggestion: Let the title container fill the space left of the rating (e.g., flex: 1 with min-width: 0). Remove any hard-coded width or clipping on the text. For long names that genuinely don't fit, truncate with an ellipsis rather than slicing a character.
